snippet.title: All Our Broken Parts // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473430/All_Our_Broken_Parts/

Experience a story-driven adventure game as a robot doctor. In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories. Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

Developed by 
锡鸟 Tin Bird
